ruling: SIG-60 comment 40386, ruling 2 (Colin, 16 November 2026), on independent review 11 (comment 40328), T3
rule: On set v2.2, drift is scored per applicant only, never per line, and these applicants are excluded from every drift result. Every run reports this list. T-drift-line-main is not used as a target.
why: Each is tagged for drift, but its truth lists no drift line: the generator's label pool doesn't exclude applicants with an unshared salary account or a history too short for the split (fixed in set v2.3, SIG-63). Derived from the regenerated truths (truth.v2.drift.transaction_ids empty) and checked against the review's three prefixes.
